title: Operating Systems and Networks
blurb: CPU and memory virtualization, networking and the transport layer, concurrency, locks and semaphores, files and file systems.

docs.title: Lectures 1 to 7: processes and scheduling
docs.about: What an OS is, processes, fork/exec/wait, limited direct execution, FIFO to MLFQ and CFS

docs.title: Lectures 8 and 9: networking

docs.title: Lectures 10 to 13: memory
docs.about: Address spaces, malloc, base and bounds, segmentation, paging, TLB, multi-level tables, swapping, replacement

docs.title: Lectures 14 to 17: concurrency
docs.about: Threads, races, locks, condition variables, semaphores, deadlock

docs.title: Lectures 18 and 19: file systems
docs.about: Files, directories, fds and offsets, links, fsync and rename, vsfs layout, inodes and the multi-level index, access-path I/O counts, caching, the xv6 file system (Tutorial 7)
